description: The caller's own location, from Cloudflare's IP geolocation (edge only: the Worker at api.forlab.io/geo answers it, the Python service does not). Only the address the request comes from is looked up, never one you send. The location is approximate, city level at best, and a value Cloudflare does not know is null. `country` is the country's place in this dataset (same shape as /v1/contains), null when the dataset lacks it. Replies carry `Cache-Control: private, no-store`. Works without a key within a daily free quota.
name: get_caller_location
title: Caller location
